working_title: Reading Water Test Results Without the Confusion

owner_input.idea: Opportunity Intelligence spin-off: turn a laboratory or screening report into understandable next questions and treatment jobs without turning one number into a complete diagnosis.
owner_input.owner_notes: Preserve Water Through the Layers at Product Design. Do not reopen the approved Water research foundation unless Product Design routes a specific evidence gap back.
owner_input.requested_angle: Evidence-first measurement literacy: read the analyte, result, units, qualifier, method sensitivity, benchmark type, sample context and decision consequence before prescribing a product.

websites_reviewed: https://academy.rebelranchministries.org (crawler fetch failed; current Program Hub GitHub source reviewed as durable source of truth)
context_review.learning_area_reason: Interpreting water-quality evidence is a practical water/resource-management skill supporting household wells, homesteads, treatment decisions and resilient systems.

conflicts_found: Public-water MCLs and action levels are useful evidence/reference points but do not make a private household well federally regulated under the Safe Drinking Water Act.
MCL, MCLG, action-level/treatment-technique and secondary/aesthetic values answer different questions and must not be flattened into one safe/unsafe number.
A non-detect does not prove absolute zero; interpretation depends on the method/reporting/detection limit supplied by the laboratory.
unresolved_questions: Product-stage market/comparable research for report interpreters, calculators and existing consumer tools
Product-stage analyte-specific expansion if an automated results interpreter is proposed
Product-stage current-threshold refresh plan so worked examples do not become stale
Product-stage interaction design for lab qualifiers and raw-versus-post-treatment sample points
